failure_modes.recovery: Upload through POST /api/spreadsheet/files (or the spreadsheet.create_with_content tool) — keys are server-minted.
failure_modes.when: r2_key is not a spreadsheets/<your tenant>/ key minted by the upload lane
folder_id names no folder in your tenant

preconditions: Agents: prefer the spreadsheet.create_with_content platform tool — it stores the bytes AND registers the row in one call.

description: Register a spreadsheet file row in the library for bytes that already sit in R2: r2_key must be a spreadsheets/<your tenant>/ key minted by the upload route or spreadsheet.create_with_content — a caller-invented, foreign-tenant, or wrong-domain key is refused. sheet_count, row_count, and column_count are unverified client-reported hints, since nothing server-side parses the binary. NEXT: spreadsheet.create_with_content stores the bytes and registers the row together.
name: spreadsheet_file_create
